age.title: Grown-ups only.
age.body: By entering you confirm you’re 18 or older. Consent can be withdrawn at any time and every card can be skipped.

read-my-mind.tagline: Can you guess what I want?
read-my-mind.description: Hide an answer, read your partner, and earn Sparks for every right guess.
rules: One of you hides an answer, the other guesses it
Right guess: +1 Spark. Wrong guess: an optional forfeit
Chemistry cards need two yeses and earn you both a Spark
Secret Missions earn Power Cards you can play later

ACTIVE.description: Either of you can stop or change your mind at any time.

CONFIRM.title: A moment completed?
CONFIRM.description: Each of you confirms once it’s truly done.

WAITING.title: Waiting for your partner
WAITING.description: You confirmed. Your partner hasn’t confirmed completion yet.

COMPLETED.title: Now That’s Chemistry!

INVITATION.note: Both of you must say yes. Your answer stays private until you both answer.

WAITING_FOR_CONSENT.note: Your yes is private until you’ve both answered, and you can still change your mind.

MUTUALLY_ACCEPTED.note: Start whenever the mood is right. Either of you can stop at any moment.

IN_PROGRESS.note: Do it for real. When it’s actually happened, you each confirm.

WAITING_FOR_COMPLETION.note: It counts once you’ve both confirmed it really happened.

chem.footer: Completing it earns you each +1 Spark. Declining costs nothing.

timer.label: Time left

desire.noNote: Not a mutual yes, so neither answer is revealed. Nobody knows who said what.

ROLE_REVERSAL.title: Role Reversal
ROLE_REVERSAL.effect: On the next Mind Reader card, the person who would normally guess hides the answer instead. The usual turns resume after it.
ROLE_REVERSAL.applied: Locked in. The next Mind Reader card swaps roles, just once.

DOUBLE_CHALLENGE.title: Double Challenge
DOUBLE_CHALLENGE.effect: The next Mind Reader card plays in two parts: part A with the usual roles, part B with roles reversed and a second, different question.
DOUBLE_CHALLENGE.applied: Locked in. The next Mind Reader card comes in two parts.

COUNTER_MIND.title: Counter Mind
COUNTER_MIND.effect: On the next Mind Reader card you both answer for yourselves and predict each other, in secret. Both reveal together.
COUNTER_MIND.applied: Locked in. On the next Mind Reader card, you read each other.

ONE_MORE_QUESTION.title: One More Question
ONE_MORE_QUESTION.effect: On the next Mind Reader card, once the answer is locked, each of you may ask the other one Yes/No question before the guess. Either of you can pass.
ONE_MORE_QUESTION.applied: Locked in. The next Mind Reader card opens with a question each.

powers.title: Hidden Claws
powers.emptyBody: Complete a Secret Mission and have your partner confirm it. Each confirmed mission earns one card. You can hold {limit}.
powers.footer: Power Cards never reveal a hidden answer, never change a result or Spark, and never skip a consent step.

PICKY_KITTY.title: Choose the Question
PICKY_KITTY.description: Get up to three fresh Mind Reader questions at tonight’s heat and pick the one you both answer on this card.
PICKY_KITTY.confirm: You’ll see up to three questions. The card is spent once you pick one; until then you can put it back.

LET_ME_IN.title: Ask Why
LET_ME_IN.description: After a reveal, ask your partner why they chose their answer. They can tell you or pass, and the result stays as it is.
LET_ME_IN.confirm: Your partner can tell you or pass. The card is spent either way.

A_LITTLE_PRESENT.title: Bonus Moment
A_LITTLE_PRESENT.description: Offer your partner one extra challenge at tonight’s heat. It only happens if you both say yes, and it never scores.
A_LITTLE_PRESENT.requirement: Either player · after a finished Mind Reader card
A_LITTLE_PRESENT.confirm: You’ll both see the challenge and decide. The card is spent either way; a no costs nothing.

steps.title: Hide it. Read it.
lines: On Mind Reader cards, one of you secretly picks an answer and the other guesses it.
Right guess: +1 Spark. Wrong guess: no Spark, plus an optional forfeit you both have to agree to.
Roles switch every Mind Reader card.

steps.title: Chemistry needs two yeses.
lines: Chemistry cards are real-life moves. Each of you answers privately.
Only if you both say yes does it start. Do it, then each tap “We did it”: +1 Spark each.
Either of you can say no or stop at any moment. It costs nothing.

steps.title: Undercover cat.
lines: You each get a private Secret Mission. Tap the lock at the top to peek.
Make it happen naturally, then claim it. Your partner sees the mission and confirms.
Confirmed missions earn Power Cards: Picky Kitty, Let Me In!, A Little Present. Find them under “Power”.

steps.title: Twists & desires.
lines: Plot Twists change the next Mind Reader card: swapped roles, a two-part challenge, reading each other, or one extra question each. You both activate them, and they never award Spark.
Mutual Desire cards are private Yes/Maybe/No. Only a mutual Yes is ever revealed.

steps.title: Skip anything.
lines: Every card has a Skip, and skipping never costs Sparks.
Cards never go above the heat your host set.
